verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Medusa ships a Product Module and machine-readable Admin REST API specs, so catalog changes can plausibly be scripted programmatically rather than made one product at a time. Nothing in the pack documents CSV import/export or bulk-edit operations specifically. Missing for 10: documented CSV product import/export, bulk edit in the admin dashboard, explicit batch/bulk API endpoints for products, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk catalog workflows.
